interface.longDescription: Root-level, read-only discovery of Codex Cloud Legacy and current-generation environments. Separates provider availability, authorization, draft state, source evidence, catalog completeness and verified resolution. No task or environment creation. Live integrations require an explicitly authorized provider.
interface.defaultPrompt: Discover my available Codex Cloud environments before starting tasks, using verified authorized providers. Return IDs, source, configuration state and completeness; never mistake missing authorization for an empty catalog.

name: codex-cloud-environment-discovery
description: Independent read-only Root discovery of Legacy and Current Codex Cloud environments with explicit evidence and fail-closed authorization handling.
